title: BuildServerNats
description: NATS subjects owned by dd-build-server (CI/CD build lifecycle, durable build-request intake, and registry image events).

$dd:nats.summary: Build server lifecycle, request intake, and image event subjects.

subjects.name: BuildServerEvents
subjects.description: Redacted build lifecycle events (queued/running/succeeded/failed) published by the build server. Default for BUILD_SERVER_NATS_EVENT_SUBJECT.
subjects.subject: dd.remote.build_server.events

subjects.name: BuildServerRequests
subjects.description: Durable build-request intake. Producers publish a build-server.v1 job document; build-server replicas consume via the shared queue group / durable JetStream consumer. Default for BUILD_SERVER_NATS_REQUEST_SUBJECT.
subjects.subject: dd.remote.build_server.requests

subjects.name: BuildServerResults
subjects.description: Terminal build results (succeeded/failed with jobId and error summary) for NATS-submitted and webhook-submitted jobs. Default for BUILD_SERVER_NATS_RESULT_SUBJECT.
subjects.subject: dd.remote.build_server.results

subjects.name: BuildServerImages
subjects.description: Redacted container-image registry events (ECR / docker registry webhook pushes) relayed by the build server. Default for BUILD_SERVER_NATS_IMAGE_SUBJECT.
subjects.subject: dd.remote.build_server.images

queueGroups.name: BuildServerQueueGroup
queueGroups.description: Shared queue group / durable consumer name used by build-server replicas for request intake.

streams.name: DD_REMOTE_BUILD_JOBS
streams.description: JetStream file storage with WorkQueue retention and explicit ack for build-request intake. Dedupe by Nats-Msg-Id ('build-request:<requestId>'); Postgres (dd_build_server) remains the real idempotency guard.
